question: Which Platinum clients missed their SLA settlement target last month?

runs.headline: Eight Platinum clients fell short of 99% settlement target in September
runs.narrative: All eight Platinum clients missed the 99.0% on-time settlement rate (POL-001 §2) in September 2026, ranging from 93.4% to 98.3%. Eastgate Capital Partners underperformed most severely at 93.4% across 4,136 instructions, while Montclair and Westmark came closest at 98.3%. Each breach triggers a 5% custody fee credit, capped at 20% monthly (POL-001 §3).
runs.sql:
SELECT c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num, COUNT(*) AS instructions, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*), 2) AS settlement_rate_pct, 99.0 AS target_pct, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*) >= 99.0 AS met_target FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_client c ON c.client_key = i.client_key JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED', 'FAILED') AND c.sla_tier = 'PLATINUM' AND d.year_num = 2026 AND d.month_num = 9 GROUP BY c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num HAVING 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*) < 99.0 ORDER BY settlement_rate_pct ASC, c.client_name
LIMIT 1000
